No. The method found no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more on ASSET-D (311.2 ha) between 2021 and 2025. Hansen data covered the full property (valid data fraction 1.0) through 2025. The JRC 2020 reference map shows about 285.6 ha (91.8% of the property) as forest.

This is not proof that nothing changed. Losses under 0.5 ha, losses at the edges, or losses narrower than the 30 m pixels could have been missed. The result also says nothing about compliance, such as EUDR status, or about any time outside 2021–2025.

One source, MGAP 2021, was unavailable. The detection rule relies on Hansen and JRC GFC2020, and both were available.
